aboutUsParagraph1: Founded with a passion for delivering high-energy experiences, Furious Quad is more than a brand; it's a commitment to exhilaration. With a heritage of expertise spanning generations, we seamlessly blend tradition with modernity, providing an unparalleled experience that aligns with your expectations.
aboutUsParagraph2: Our team consists of dedicated professionals who share a profound love for adventure, ensuring that every tour becomes a memorable journey into the heart of excitement with your safety as our top priority.
whyUsParagraph: In the world of Furious Adventures, your safety is our top priority. When you join our thrilling Quad bike, Buggy, and Motocross tours in Morocco, know that each turn in the Marrakech desert is carefully crafted with your security in mind. Our dedication to a safe and exciting experience ensures your well-being is our priority in every adventure we offer.
faqQ1Question: 1. Is it possible to pay on site ?
faqQ1Answer: No, we currently do not offer online payment options. However, we are in the process of developing our website to integrate a secure payment system in the near future. Thank you for your understanding.
faqQ2Question: 2. I haven’t received any confirmation after my online booking. What should I do?
faqQ2Answer: If you haven't received your confirmation, please reach out to us via E-mail at furiousmarrakech@gmail.com or WhatsApp at +212 6 06 04 02 70, and we'll promptly assist you with more details.
faqQ3Question: 3. My hotel is out of Marrakech and I am asked to pay supplement for the transfer. Why?
faqQ3Answer: Our transfers services cover the Medina and Center of Marrakech without extra charges, within the limit of 5 kilometers out of the city. Some hotels are out of the city and this adds a lot of kilometers for the drivers. The supplements are only to cover the time, the gas and the use of the vehicle. Supplement is usually 5€ / person, or more if hotel is far out. If you don’t feel like paying a supplement, ask your hotel if there is a shuttle going to the Center. After, we can make an appointment there. To confirm if your hotel is in the free-of-charge zone, please send an E-mail at furiousmarrakech@gmail.com or contact us via WhatsApp at +212 6 06 04 02 70.
faqQ4Question: 4. Can I arrange my pick up (Drop off) from (to) somewhere else in Marrakech instead of my hotel?
faqQ4Answer: Yes, this is possible if you inform us by E-mail, WhatsApp or Instagram at least 24 hours in advance. Supplement fees may apply if requested place is out of the center of Marrakech.
faqQ5Question: 5. Does Furious Quad Marrakech provide group discount?
faqQ5Answer: We can propose discounts for large groups, but it is important to know that sometimes more people means also more logistics.... In any way, we always aim to provide the best rates possible. Just contact us by E-mail at furiousmarrakech@gmail.com.
faqQ6Question: 6. Are there sand dunes around Marrakech?
faqQ6Answer: No. It's rocky desert with beautiful palm trees, and a climb to the top of the small mountains near Marrakech called “Jbilat”, for stunning panoramic views.
faqQ7Question: 7. Do I need a special insurance to participate in activities?
faqQ7Answer: Each participant is responsible for their own insurance coverage. Furious Quad Marrakech advises everybody travelling in Morocco to have complete travel insurance that covers medical fees, ambulance, repatriation, etc. Make sure you are covered! Depending on the activity you’ve chosen, you may need complementary travel insurance. Here is a website where you can subscribe to extra coverage for outdoor activities, please check it.
